name: yuanbao-crawler-web
input_files: required standard inputs: repeat count, target entity, entity type, OpenCLI profile
optional YUANBAO_GROUP env: move each fresh conversation into a named 元宝对话分组 after share creation
output_contract: summary.json analysis metrics with target entity recognition and same-type competitor comparison
share.url / share_id / share.error per sample (auto public share creation, default enabled)
structured-data.md Markdown export of cleaned structured fields and analysis tables
field-maps/<question_id>-data-map.html per-question data field map (first valid sample)
structured-data.xlsx Excel workbook with the same structured sheets as the Markdown export

report.html Kami-styled visual report with overview, directory, metric explanations, entity classification, probability tables, target-vs-competitor module, clickable citations with unique compact URL labels, GEO trend projections, and capped detail lists
rollback_boundary: The skill writes local artifacts only to the selected run output directory. Fresh crawling creates 腾讯元宝 web conversations in the connected browser; it does not modify external source projects.
local_dependencies: Node.js 21+ for fresh crawling; Node.js 18+ for analysis-only and share-link parsing
Auto-creates a public share link (page share API, with UI click/clipboard fallback) and parses the full share page
Logged-in 腾讯元宝 web session for fresh crawling
Bundled scripts/yuanbao_browser_crawl.mjs using the OpenCLI yuanbao site adapter
Bundled scripts/analyze_yuanbao_share.mjs using Node fetch for public share pages
